pull_request.title: Calorimeter: validate central 50 GeV electron raw and sampling response
pull_request.head: codex/ecal50gev-central
pull_request.body:
Adds a **second validation set from dedicated single-electron simulation** at total energy **50 GeV, η=0.1, φ=+0.7°** for the selected restored LAr baseline and staggered Si–W. Each model has **2,000 independent calibration + 10,000 held-out evaluation events**; the previous broad-spectrum sample is not reused.

![Raw deposits and corrected response](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal50gev-central/docs/validation/ecal50gev-central/figures/central-response-distributions.png?raw=true)

The three columns show raw active Geant4 energy S, R=S/50, and T=S/(50f), with f=mean_cal(S/50). This is an effective visible response fraction including containment/dead-material losses. Evaluation is not recentered, and constant scaling leaves SD/mean unchanged. Raw sensitive barrel+endcap sums are used before digitization; passive energy is not separately scored.

| Model | Mean S [GeV] | Independent f | SD(T) [%], pointwise 95% interval |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| LAr restored | 8.05839 | 0.161232 | 2.694 [2.639, 2.763] |
| Si–W staggered | 0.782269 | 0.0156327 | 3.219 [3.087, 3.405] |

The favourable Si–W direction was selected from geometry before new showers: 10.55° from a sector boundary, at least 16.80 mm tangential active clearance, 44/48 reference-ray active crossings. Four small axial row gaps remain; no global response-optimum or completely gap-free claim. The same point is used for LAr.

All **24,000 production events** and **200 excluded pilot events** pass full native readback. Exact models/libraries, primaries, field/cuts/step policies, four initial seed streams and complete counts are bound. Independent source/results review reproduces 18 metrics, all six histograms, all 18 bootstrap intervals, covariance and contrasts; 14 tests pass. All six PNG/PDF/SVG exports reproduce byte-for-byte from the compact summary and were visually checked. Large ROOT/event/XML payloads remain local and ignored; only aggregates, code, figures, controls and exact reproduction commands are included.

A native diagnostic found one repeated internal event seed within Si–W evaluation (23,999 distinct seeds among 24,000 generated events), with no cross-calibration/evaluation or detector sharing. All events and the frozen nominal bootstrap are retained. Separate post-hoc conservative first-order cluster sensitivity changes the width SE by less than 0.0002% relative; no resimulation or response-based selection.

[Results, limits and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal50gev-central/docs/validation/ecal50gev-central/README.md). This is an ECAL-only B=0, fixed-point raw-deposition diagnostic; no electronics/full-detector or engineering acceptance.

Stacked on draft PR152 to keep this new set separate. Tracking: TASK-ECAL50GEV-CENTRAL; DES-030/031/032/033. Draft delivery follows the standing human instruction in AGENTS.md (2026-11-06); no ready-for-review action or merge.
